profile.text: Rockrock, a member of the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps, cooperated with Rhodes Island during the Londinium crisis and is experienced in reconnaissance and long-ranged assault. At her own suggestion, she has reached a partnership with Rhodes Island's Londinium branch.
